decision.rationale: Reconciliation is clean and the updated TIP contains no additional constraint. Binance now clearly supports the bearish thesis: BTC is around 76709, short-term bias is bearish, price is trading very close to the 24h low, and the last 12h/24h moves are negative. Beecthor's recent view also remains bearish, expecting continuation lower if price stays weak. The weekly 76k dip is already the right structural position and is working well, but the daily thesis slot is currently free. On the April 27 daily board, the closest unresolved bearish strike is 76k dip at about 35.5%, only around 709 dollars below spot with six hours still remaining. That is the cleanest same-day expression of the current move. Lower daily dip strikes are too weak, and upside reach markets are even weaker and contradict the live tape. The disciplined move is to add the daily 76k dip alongside the existing weekly 76k dip, using the early-stage $1 cap.
